A controversial, taxpayer-funded Trump ad has been dramatically reimagined by a veterans group.

VoteVets, the progressive PAC representing veterans and military families, parodied Trump's "Final Mission" ad — which ripped off a clip he's shared for years and was one of three taxpayer-funded ads released ahead of the 2026 midterm elections that sparked public outrage this week.

In VoteVets' version, Trump walks down the same hallway, but the message conveyed is drastically different.

During the parody, Reuters headlines flash on screen: "Trump's approval rating hits historic low of 32% as cost of living soars."

A Fox News screenshot then appears, showing Trump alongside his sons Eric and Don Jr., with the headline: "The biggest scam in history."

When the reimagined version's narrator talks about booting out "the weak and ineffective," clips of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth immediately follow.
